data.name: Grid Ranger
data.detailed_description:
Feature List

  • Fast paced gameplay. Build dexterity as you weave between obstacles and destroy enemies

  • Linear Targeting. Balance your movement between aiming and dodging

  • Endless Replay. Either play through the levels or enter an endless mode for play that never ends

  • Nuanced Pacing. Move between different areas filled with different styles of obstacles and enemies, all in the same run. 


About the Game

 YOU CANNOT ESCAPE THE GRID.

…or can you? Grid Ranger is an arcade style shoot-em-up with laser sharp aesthetics and a retro-futuristic soundtrack. Practice your mouse dexterity as you blow through obstacles and dodge projectiles in a game reminiscent of the arcade.

Trade your Blows

Use your projectiles to target objects in your path, creating new ways to move through the grid.

  • Linear Targeting: Use the grid against them by firing along it. Line up your character to take aim at enemies.

  • Dodge and Weave: Avoid obstacles that might end your run while targeting the opponents in front of you.

Power Up your Escape.
Dodge and weave between enemies to pick up extra lives in preparation for the boss at the end of each level.

  • Destroy your Enemies: explode different targets and collect the glittering diamonds they leave behind.

  • Extra Chances: Salvage a run by grabbing extra lives from destroyed enemies.

  • Be Prepared: Each level ends with a unique boss and attack sets. Do your best to grab new powerups and gain an edge on each level.

Advance Beyond the Grid

Play across three levels and an infinite mode in a difficulty of your choosing, all while immersed in the arcade game atmosphere. Featuring 8 original tracks and precise retro graphics, this is a nostalgia hit you won’t want to miss. Do you have what it takes to escape the grid?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: 1 Ghz CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent, Integrated cards also work
  • Storage: 250 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: 10.15 or higher
  • Processor: 1 Ghz CPU - Apple M1 or Intel Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
